menus.name: Holiday Menu
intro: This season, we invite you to celebrate with ease.
Whether you're planning a festive gathering, heading to a holiday potluck, or suddenly need a Christmas dinner that tastes like you planned it for weeks, we've got you covered.

Epic Flavor brings chef-crafted comfort right to your table with our all-new customizable holiday catering menu, complete with spirited holiday appetizers and salads, decadent meals, delicious side dishes, and dreamy desserts.
Modifications (including portions and ingredients) can be made to any menu item, and vegetarian meals are available upon request.
